text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming victory for Biwa Hayahide! 
A magnificent win with a phenomenal time!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The younger sister was amazing, but the 
older sister was just as incredible!! 
Dreams of a sibling showdown are growing 
tremendously!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaaaaaahhhh!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I have returned, Trainer-kun. 
Victory belongs to us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yeah. That's one goal down, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I... have reached the pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"On the grand stage of the Takarazuka 
Kinen, where only chosen Umamusume can 
run, she shone brightly in 1st place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide smiles proudly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fufu, likewise.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Still, challenges remain. For I will run 
the greatest race with my sister and 
defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And in putting that into practice, 
concrete problems began to surface.
choice_data_list: Which race do you want to face off in?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: That's it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fortunately, in regards to this, some data 
has been coming in in the form of 
articles.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“Narita Brian's next race is the Kikuka 
Sho” ...Yeah, that's only natural. And she 
will become a Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, here it is. 'Sisters showdown 
at year's end?' 'Narita Brian, heading to 
the Arima Kinen?'"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suspect that's quite likely as well. Not 
the 'Japan Cup'— she will definitely come 
to the 'Arima Kinen.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If they're going to challenge, they'll 
surely come into the race in top 
condition.
choice_data_list:
So the sisters' showdown is the Arima 
Kinen, huh?

So the sisters' showdown is the Arima 
Kinen, then.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And just like how she's tuning up by 
running in the Kikuka-sho, I want to 
sharpen myself up in the autumn GⅠ races 
too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a rotation planned around 
the Arima Kinen. Ideally, to counter 
Narita Brian, I'd like to get used to 
speed duels as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What a coincidence. I was just about to 
suggest that very strategy as our best 
move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrrrrooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, having set our new goal as the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), on the way home from 
Hanshin Racecourse—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the seat next to mine, I could hear 
Biwa Hayahide softly breathing in her 
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, she often falls asleep like 
this after races."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When you run all-out every single time 
like that, it's only natural for fatigue 
to accumulate subconsciously.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In order to maintain my current peak 
performance, perhaps I should learn more 
effective methods for fatigue recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the bus ride, I continued to 
brainstorm various ideas for Biwa 
Hayahide's sake...
